机制概述: Sagas has 1 Mirror Token he can use to copy an opponents' bonuses and penalties. He fights by copying and negating the opponent's attacks.

效果.效果: Use Mirror (gain all bonuses and penalties to Range, Power, Priority, and Guard that are currently applied to the Opponent. Do not gain bonuses and penalties that are applied after anteing Mirror).

效果.条件: a Base in the Opponent's Discard Pile 1 has the same name as your attack's Base
